name: indahl-qia-calibration
description: Check the IBM Quantum calibration record a run depends on, before the run (stale, zero, T2 above 2xT1, split T1/T2 measurements) and after it (which record was in force, what changed). Read-only, standard library only. Also measures T1 and T2 together on chosen qubits in one job (self-test free; the paid run only from your own terminal).
